challenge.title: Bargaining and Getting There
challenge.instructions: Write and say a short Darija conversation of at least 10 lines. It must include asking the price of something, bargaining it down at least once, agreeing on a price, hailing a taxi or asking about the bus, saying where you want to go, and asking about the fare or the time. Use at least 8 target phrases from this unit and include both a masculine-address form and a feminine-address form.
required_elements: A price question using بشحال هادا؟ or بشحال الكيلو؟
At least one attempt to lower the price, using نقص شوية or واش كاين شي تخفيض؟
An agreement using واخا or آخر ثمن.
Hailing transport using واش خاوي؟ or naming طاكسي or طوبيس.
A destination using بغيت نمشي ل or ديني ل.
A question about fare or time using شحال خاصني نخلص؟ or شحال كتاخد الطريق؟
Both a masculine-address form (such as نقص or وقف) and a feminine-address form (such as نقصي or وقفي).
